note: tannim (for tannin) is a great water creature, here the Nile crocodile as an image of Pharaoh; "dragon" suggests a fire-breathing beast of later legend.
mimmigdol seveneh names two border towns, Migdol in the north-east delta and Syene (Aswan) in the south, giving a north-to-south merism; KJV took migdol as a common noun "tower".
